toolchainNotes: Use the exact packageManager version. The verified machine pnpm.cmd entry is C:/Users/pengj/Tools/MarkTextDevelopment/pnpm.cmd.

Git-shell commit hooks need a pnpm launcher and Git >=2.32. The machine default Git 2.16 cannot run lint-staged 17; use an already-installed supported Git in the task process instead of disabling hooks.

Pandoc oracle tests were verified with Pandoc 3.13. Anaconda Pandoc 2.11 parses the nested-list fixture differently; use the verified version and rerun rather than changing the assertion or skipping the test.

localEvidence.candidate: Repeated real copy/paste diagnostics: 49 passed, 6 failed on the interactive Windows session.
localEvidence.pureUpstream: Freshly installed/built, product source unchanged: 49 passed, 6 failed; every failure snapshot reported rdpclip as clipboard owner.
localEvidence.independentControl: A minimal Electron 45 program with no MarkText/TextPack code wrote text/HTML/PNG directly. 4 of 60 later samples no longer matched its write; snapshots included rdpclip ownership and foreign SnowShotScreenshot formats.
localEvidence.interpretation: The observed local clipboard replacement is independent of TextPack. Clipboard ownership by rdpclip alone is not sufficient to classify a failure; examine data replacement and runtime comparisons.
